title: Public Deliberation Plan: Prevention of Custodial Torture Violence and Accountability Bill
proposal: Prevention of Custodial Torture Violence and Accountability Bill

publication.plain_language_summary: Absolute criminalization of custodial torture (7 yrs to Life Imprisonment), statutory reversal of burden of proof, medical exam within 2 hours, ₹25 Lakhs victim compensation.
publication.full_draft: Draft text published on MHA & Law Ministry portal.
publication.impact_notes: Human rights and criminal justice impact notes.
publication.evidence_register: Law Commission 273rd report on anti-torture, D.K. Basu judgment.

deliberation.stakeholder_roundtables: Roundtables with NHRC, State Human Rights Commissions, Bar Associations

remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Substantive structural changes to burden of proof rules
